title: Language models compress human preference geometry while political structure remains prompt-sensitive
abstract: arXiv:2611.28383v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models are increasingly used to construct synthetic publics. Prior work has documented errors in individual responses, population heterogeneity, and prompt robustness, but whether these failures reflect a common loss of fidelity or distinct properties of synthetic populations remains unclear. We tested this using matched pairwise policy choices from 1,991 Chilean, 843 French, and 434 Brazilian adults replayed through three open-weight model families. Across a 27-condition Chilean grid and cross-country factorial replications, no condition jointly reproduced individual choices, population heterogeneity, and political organization. The most consistent result was compression of the latent preference space: synthetic participant variance was only 0.4-10.5% of the corresponding human reference in the primary comparisons and remained below human variance in all 270 matched refits. translated_title: 语言模型压缩人类偏好几何结构，而政治结构仍对提示条件敏感
translated_abstract: 大语言模型正越来越多地被用于构建合成公众。先前的研究已经记录了个体回答中的错误、群体异质性以及提示鲁棒性问题，但这些失败究竟反映了共同保真度的丧失，还是合成人群的独特属性，目前仍不清楚。我们通过让三个开源权重模型家族重放1,991名智利成人、843名法国成人和434名巴西成人的匹配政策成对选择来检验这一问题。在包含27个条件的智利实验网格以及跨国因子复现实验中，没有任何条件能够同时再现个体选择、群体异质性和政治组织结构。最一致的结果是潜在偏好空间被压缩：在主要比较中，合成参与者的方差仅为相应人类参照方差的0.4%至10.5%，并且在全部270次匹配重拟合中始终低于人类方差。政治结构对提示条件则敏感得多（原文摘要此处截断）。
tldr: 语言模型在重放人类政策选择时会严重压缩潜在偏好空间（合成参与者方差仅为人类的0.4%–10.5%），且无法同时再现个体选择、群体异质性和政治组织结构，其政治组织表现对提示条件高度敏感。
en_tdlr: When replaying human policy choices, language models severely compress the latent preference space (synthetic variance only 0.4–10.5% of human variance) and fail to jointly reproduce individual choices, population heterogeneity, and political organization, with political structure remaining highly sensitive to prompt conditions.
